sql_query:
SELECT
    object.oid,
    object.ndet,
    object.firstmjd,
    object.lastmjd,
    probability.probability,
    ss_ztf.candid,
    ss_ztf.ssdistnr,
    ss_ztf.ssnamenr,
    detection.mjd,
    detection.fid
FROM object
INNER JOIN probability
    ON object.oid = probability.oid
INNER JOIN ss_ztf
    ON object.oid = ss_ztf.oid
INNER JOIN detection
    ON ss_ztf.candid = detection.candid
WHERE object.ndet > 500
  AND probability.class_name = 'asteroid'
  AND probability.classifier_name = 'stamp_classifier'
  AND probability.classifier_version = 'stamp_classifier_1.0.4'
  AND probability.probability > 0.5
  AND probability.ranking = 1
  AND ss_ztf.ssdistnr < 2
ORDER BY object.firstmjd ASC
LIMIT 10

    g_r_max_corr DOUBLE PRECISION, /* g-r color at maximum*/

    g_r_mean_corr DOUBLE PRECISION, /* mean g-r color */

    INNER JOIN ss_ztf s ON s.oid = o.oid

      AND p.class_name = 'asteroid'
      AND p.probability > 0.5
